task: Open Edge browser, go to https://railway.com/dashboard, wait for page to load, click the 'New Project' button, select 'Deploy from GitHub repo', in the search box type 'chao8-watermark-free', click on the repo 'a42599-blip/chao8-watermark-free', confirm Dockerfile is detected, click 'Deploy'. Wait 2-3 minutes until the status shows green 'Online'. Then go to Settings -> Networking and check that a railway.app domain was generated.
